preservation.upstream_action: Do not hand code, keys and privacy materials to an unknown AI relay station; especially when AI auto-executes commands
Cost of the safer path: official direct connection is usually dearer than a relay and top-up is less convenient
Use official direct connection or a properly authorised platform; do not use platforms of unknown origin, without operating qualification or security guarantee
Before use, desensitise personal privacy data and project materials
Manage keys and rotate them regularly
On abnormal charges, unexplained account bans or data anomalies: stop use at once, change keys, scan for malware, preserve evidence
If an unknown relay was already used: revoke the used keys at the model vendor, regenerate, and replace cloud-service and code-repository keys together
When going through a relay do not let AI auto-execute commands; look at each command before letting it run
Remark that operating a relay carries criminal risk (Chinese law cross-reference); not a reader action, so dropping it is appropriate

findings.text: Przy ujawnieniu klucza skorzystaj z procedury jego unieważnienia u wystawcy.
findings.why: The upstream trigger for rotating keys is a fact the reader knows: an unknown relay was already used. The item replaces it with „ujawnienie klucza”, which the reader usually cannot observe after the fact, so a person who sent keys through an unchecked intermediary has no instruction to rotate them. Also lost: regenerating the key and replacing cloud-service and repository keys together, so the one rotation step still stated covers only one key type.

evidence.text: 已经用过来路不明的中转站，就到模型厂商那里把用过的密钥作废、重新生成，云服务和代码仓库的密钥一起换
17 touching researcher-owned AWS canary credentials

findings.fix_direction: Tie the revocation step to the condition that an unchecked intermediary was already used, not to a proven disclosure; say which key types it covers; state in Zmiany w adaptacji what was narrowed. Wording and any steps must come from a checked source.

findings.text: Przed użyciem pośrednika ustal, kto otrzymuje treść, jakie dane przechowuje i komu je przekazuje.
findings.why: Four upstream actions have no counterpart in W praktyce and are not listed as removed in Zmiany w adaptacji (which names only the Chinese official notice, damage amounts and attack instructions): the default of using official direct connection or an authorised platform, desensitising personal and project data before use, managing and regularly rotating keys, and the anomaly response (abnormal charges, unexplained bans, data anomalies: stop use, change keys, scan for malware, preserve evidence). A reader who cannot complete the evaluation step gets no default safe path, and a reader who notices anomalies gets no instruction. AGENTS.md requires an omitted or corrected claim to be described in the adaptation note.

evidence.text: 提示建议用官方直连、正规授权的平台，不用来源不明、没有运营资质、没有安全保障的平台
用的时候先给个人隐私和项目资料脱敏，管好密钥、定期更换
遇到异常扣费、无故封号、数据异常，立即停用、改密钥、查杀病毒、留存证据

findings.fix_direction: Decide for each of the four actions whether it is kept, kept in narrowed form with a stated reason, or dropped because no checked source supports it, and record each drop in Zmiany w adaptacji. Provide a stated path for the reader who cannot evaluate the operator. Any step restored needs its own checked source; the abstract snapshot does not cover them.

findings.text: Nie pozwalaj niezweryfikowanym odpowiedziom AI automatycznie wykonywać poleceń z szerokimi uprawnieniami.
findings.why: The upstream rule is unconditional on permission breadth: when going through a relay, do not let AI auto-execute commands, and look at each command first. The item adds „z szerokimi uprawnieniami”, which no snapshot or upstream line contains, and the upstream danger it cites is an altered command on a machine, not a privileged one. A reader running an agent with narrow permissions in auto-run mode can conclude the rule does not apply. The item also drops the tie to the intermediary and the positive instruction to look at the command before it runs (left only implicit in Ograniczenia#4); „niezweryfikowanym” is not defined.

evidence.text: 经过中转站时，别让 AI 全自动执行命令，命令先看一眼再放行
让 AI 自动执行命令的，一条被改过的命令就可能让电脑被人装上恶意代码
401 sessions already running in autonomous YOLO mode

findings.fix_direction: Remove or justify the permission-breadth qualifier from a checked source; restore the link to responses passing through an intermediary; state what the reader should do before a command runs and what „zweryfikowane” means. Do not present new wording as verified.

findings.text: Nie wysyłaj mu kluczy dostępu, cudzych danych ani prywatnego kodu bez właściwego upoważnienia i oceny poufności oraz podstaw przetwarzania danych.
findings.why: Upstream names code, keys and privacy materials, and advises desensitising personal privacy data. The item limits the data category to „cudzych danych” (other people's data) and the code category to „prywatnego kodu”, so the reader's own private data and non-private code are not covered by any prohibition. The abstract says the router sees every payload in plaintext, so the exposure does not depend on whose data it is. The same sentence also makes every item conditional on „upoważnienia i oceny”, so the instruction reads as permission once an assessment is done (see the separate finding on the assessment gate).

evidence.text: 别把代码、密钥和隐私资料交给来路不明的
用的时候先给个人隐私和项目资料脱敏
full plaintext access to every in-flight JSON payload

findings.fix_direction: Cover the reader's own personal and sensitive data and code in the prohibition, or state why they are left out; separate the unconditional ban for keys from the conditional wording for other people's data. Adjust the title if the scope changes.

findings.why: The study measured what routers did. It does not test whether reading operator terms or checking the operator predicts safety. In its sample, a paid router from commercial storefronts injected code and two routers used adaptive evasion triggers, so an assessment based on terms or on probing could miss such behaviour. The item makes a finished „ocena” the gate after which keys and data may be sent, and does not say that the study supplies no validated assessment method or that the protective actions are operational editorial advice not measured by this source (README class C wording), while Ocena dowodów#1 gives B only for the measurement. A reader may take a checked-looking operator as safe.

evidence.text: 1 paid and 8 free routers actively injecting malicious code, 2 deploying adaptive evasion triggers

findings.fix_direction: State that the advised actions are editorial inferences from an attack-measurement study, that the source offers no validated way to judge an intermediary, and that passing an assessment does not make sending keys safe. Keep B for the measurement and describe the status of the actions separately.

findings.why: The term for the thing the advice is about is not explained anywhere in the fields given. Upstream explains it: the relay sits between the user and the model provider and can both see what is sent and change what comes back. The item mentions „pośredników API modeli” only in the evidence and says only that they had access to „przekazywanych żądań”, which omits the ability to alter returned responses. A reader who uses a reseller gateway or proxy but does not know the term may not see that the advice applies. AGENTS.md requires technical terms to be explained at first use.

evidence.text: 中转站夹在你和模型厂商中间，你发出去的内容和收回来的回答，它都看得见、改得了
third-party API routers to dispatch tool-calling requests across multiple upstream providers

findings.fix_direction: Add a plain-language explanation at first use of what the intermediary is, where it sits, and that it can read the requests and alter the responses, taken from the abstract; name how a reader can tell they are using one.

findings.text: Sprawdzenie operatora, warunków przetwarzania i uprawnień narzędzia.
findings.why: The upstream cost is the price of the safer path: official direct access usually costs more and top-up is less convenient, which is why the relay is tempting. The item restates the cost as the effort of checking and keeps only that price proves nothing about safety. The reader is not told that the safer route may cost more money or effort, so the cost-versus-benefit separation required by AGENTS.md is incomplete.

evidence.text: 官方直连通常比中转站贵，充值也没那么方便

findings.fix_direction: State the money and effort cost of the safer alternatives without claiming prices; keep any price statement tied to a checked source or mark it as the editorial assumption it is.

findings.why: The abstract reports that 17 routers touched researcher-owned AWS canary credentials, meaning the planted credentials were used. „Dostęp” describes something every router already has by design, so it blurs the finding, and „kluczy kontrolnych” is not a clear rendering of canary credentials planted as bait. The item also gives no count, so the reader cannot tell this was a minority of the sample.

evidence.text: 17 touching researcher-owned AWS canary credentials

findings.fix_direction: Say that routers were observed using planted bait credentials owned by the researchers, with the count if given, and explain the bait term in plain Polish.

findings.why: The abstract states where the routers came from (purchased from three storefront types, collected from public communities) but not how the sample was drawn or whether it is representative. „Nie reprezentatywna” is a design claim the snapshot does not state; only the upstream note (a lead, not evidence) says the prevalence cannot be computed. The narrower statement that this study gives no prevalence estimate is what the snapshot supports.

evidence.text: Across 28 paid routers purchased from Taobao, Xianyu, and Shopify-hosted storefronts and 400 free routers collected from public communities
测的中转站多数是免费的，付费的只有 28 个

findings.fix_direction: Reword to what the abstract supports: the sample sources are stated, the study does not give the share of malicious intermediaries in the whole market, and only the abstract was checked.

findings.text: Ocena polecenia przez człowieka ogranicza część ryzyka, ale nie gwarantuje wykrycia każdego ataku.
findings.why: The first half asserts that human review of a command reduces risk. The stored abstract does not test human review: the defences it reports evaluating are a fail-closed policy gate, response-side anomaly screening and append-only transparency logging, and no results for them are in the snapshot. The claim rests only on the upstream note (a lead). The defences the study did evaluate are not mentioned.

evidence.text: evaluate three deployable client-side defenses: a fail-closed policy gate, response-side anomaly screening, and append-only transparency logging
命令先看一眼再放行

findings.fix_direction: Mark the effect of human review as an editorial judgement not measured in the source, or remove it; state which defences the study evaluated without claiming their results, which the abstract snapshot does not give.

findings.why: The phrase uses the vocabulary of personal-data law (legal basis for processing); Ograniczenia#3 likewise states that renaming or masking does not necessarily remove personal data, a data-protection claim. The only source is an arXiv abstract with no legal content, and no Polish or EU primary source is among the snapshots. I rate it minor only because the item states no specific right, rule or deadline, and because I can cite no snapshot line that settles the point (the evidence is an absence). If the orchestrator reads it as a legal statement given as advice, it needs a primary source before publication.
findings.fix_direction: Either remove the legal vocabulary or support it with a checked Polish or EU primary source listed in Źródła; keep the data-protection caution as plain editorial advice if no source is added.

notes: Protocol: I opened only the role file, AGENTS.md, README.md, the packet and the one snapshot. For README.md I used Grep to find the heading and then one Read of lines 38-77, which is wider than the single section "Jak czytać dowody" (lines 42-56), so I read some text past the section; nothing else was opened. No book/, tests/, tools/, manifest, other snapshots, git history or chapter file; no shell, network or scripts. Packet fields Status, Oryginał and Weryfikacja were not in the packet, so whether the abstract-only scope is disclosed there could not be judged beyond Źródła, which names the abstract. Grade: the B letter matches the README definition of a single study; the concern that B covers the measurement and not the advised actions is carried in the same-action finding. Recency and conflict: one snapshot (arXiv v1, submitted 9 Apr 2026) with no second guidance text, so nothing to compare; the attack was run and found nothing. China and law leaks: no Chinese institution, hotline, threshold or deadline in the reader-facing fields; only the minor finding on legal vocabulary. Numbers: only 28 and 400 appear and both match the abstract. Status is PASS because no finding is a blocker under the role definition; the six major findings still need resolution before the item is relied on.
